text:
Chris: spontaneous indie co-op tonight? thinking 8pm-ish in the mezz. short campaign, 4-player max. whos in? :video_game:
Dana: i'm down if someone brings a Switch or controllers. got motion-sickness though so prefer couch co-op not VR. :sweat_smile:
Morgan: can bring my Switch + dock. also have a USB-C -> HDMI dongle and a short HDMI cable.
Riley: i can bring the extra Xbox controller and a tiny travel router for LAN. wired > wifi if possible.
Zoe: food plan? i'll donate a box of cookies and some sodas. vegetarian options included. :cookie:
Chris: sweet. need one more player to cap at 4. anyone else?
Dana: can we do a quick poll: prefer start at 8, 8:30, or 9? react with :one: 8pm, :two: 8:30, :three: 9pm
Morgan: :two:
Riley: :one: (early bird)
Zoe: :three: (need to finish errands)
Chris: hmm split, ok tentatively 8:30.
office-bot: calendar invite created: "Mezz Indie Night" at 2024-06-14T20:30:00Z.
Dana: also - last time the mezz projector's remote battery died. anyone bring spare AAA?
Morgan: got AAA. will put them next to the dock.
Riley: bringing a tiny power strip and surge protector this time. no more scavenging under desks.
Zoe: reminder: please keep the meeting rooms bookable. we'll avoid long setups and clear by 11pm.
Chris: plan: Morgan (Switch host), Riley (Xbox pad + router), Dana (brings cozy blanket), Zoe (snacks). rotating queue for extra folks.
Dana: can someone tag newcomers in the Slack so they can join?
Riley: @Jordan @Alex -- you guys into a chill co-op?
Morgan: quick logistics: if anyone wants to stream clips locally, set OBS to record to external drive. office Wi-Fi blocks streaming ports.
Zoe: brought sticky notes for controller handoff this time. last handoff chaos was real. :laughing:
Chris: final ask: anyone want to sign up to bring chairs? mezz couch seats 3.
Dana: i can bring 2 folding chairs.
Riley: i'll bring a small lamp to keep things cozy but not blinding.
Morgan: cool. see you all 8:30. bringing my indie game recommendations list too.
Zoe: see ya! snacks are labeled. please throw wrappers in compost bin. :leafy_green:
